title: the panel's password reset page, contract version 1
description: The props of the page a password reset link opens (PRD 5.16), Auth/ResetPassword in js/panel. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\ResetPasswordPage, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

action.description: The address the form posts to.

forgot.description: The address of the page that asks for a new link.

login.description: The address of the login page.

refusals.description: The catalog code of the refusal of the reset just posted, under the password when it is about the password and under form otherwise; null where there is none.

token.description: The token of the link that opened the page, or null when its address holds no text in the form of a token.

refusals.description: The refusals of a reset, by the field they are about.

form.description: The refusal that is not about the password, or null: password_reset_token_invalid for a link that is unknown, used or expired, and breached_passwords_unavailable when the breach check could not be made.

password.description: The refusal about the password, or null: validation_required, password_too_short, password_too_long or password_breached.
